drawings.notes: Redrawn on a wider crop, which brings in the s of the transcription at the far left (outside the earlier crop). Read on the page: s (top left), a segment falling to the right towards u, a small circle under it; u, a segment, a small circle above it, v (overinked); a segment rising to the right towards t, a small circle under it. So the path s - u - v - t, each segment marked by one small circle; the segments stop short of the letters, as drawn. Not drawn: the scribbled trial below it, struck through (several crossing strokes and a zigzag). Still differs: the transcription speaks of segments from s and t to u and v and of circles marking vertices; on the page there are three segments (s-u, u-v, v-t) and the circles sit beside the segments, not at the letters. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again. Question settled by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (maths): the sentence just above the figure asks for u, v such that (s, u, v, t) is an A_0-chain: the figure is the path s - u - v - t of three segments, as the page shows, and the small circle beside each segment is the mark « 0 » of A_0, not a vertex; as drawn. The scribbled trial under it is crossed by a zigzag and several strokes: struck, and leaving it out stands. Not checked by a reader. 2026-11-13, Claude Opus 5.5, overlay check (issue 147): rasterised from its own coordinates over the 400 dpi colour scan (250 ppi native) on a unit grid; s, the segment falling to u with its small circle, u, the segment to v with its circle above, v (overinked), the segment rising towards t with its circle, t: every stroke and circle lies on its ink to within about 1 unit and the segments stop short of the letters as on the page. The scribbled trial under the figure is a tangle of loops and strokes crossed out, not a figure that can be read under its strike, and stays left out (crossings-out are not figures). The disagreement with the transcription was applied on 12 November (#145). Not compiled (no TeX in the session). Status set to ok; the redraw is unchanged.

drawings.description: deux arcs de courbe se faisant face. À gauche, un point $s$ relié à un point $t$ situé sur un arc d'extrémités $t'$ et $t''$, avec à l'extrême gauche un point $\sigma t$ ; à droite, l'image par $\lambda$ : un point $\lambda t$ sur un arc d'extrémités $t'$ et $t''$ (traits renforcés), relié à $\lambda^{-1}s = s'$. Entre les deux, une flèche $\xrightarrow[u_\lambda]{\lambda}$ et une flèche de retour $\xleftarrow[u_{\lambda^{-1}}]{\lambda^{-1}}$.

Right: the image arc (strokes reinforced, doubled) through lambda t, with t' and t'' marked; from lambda t a stroke to the right ending in an arrow at lambda^{-1}s = s' (label at the edge). Faint strokes join t to t' and towards t'' on the right arc. Arrows lambda / u_lambda above and lambda^{-1} / u_{lambda^{-1}} below. A small curved arrow at the top left is not drawn.
